definitions.explanation: The organic acid that gives vinegar its sour taste and pungent smell. Used in chemistry, food science, cleaning products, and industrial processes. The chemical formula is CH₃COOH.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主成分|しゅせいぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酢酸|さくさん}だ。
examples.english: The main component of vinegar is acetic acid.

examples.japanese: {酢酸|さくさん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Acetic acid can also be used for cleaning.

examples.japanese: {酢酸|さくさん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発酵|はっこう}→発酵：13605_hakkou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{作|つく}られ→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{食品|しょくひん}{保存|ほぞん}→食品保存：24935_shokuhinhozon⟧や⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: Acetic acid is produced through fermentation and has been used since ancient times for food preservation and as a seasoning.

notes:
Composed of {酢|さく} (vinegar) and ⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧ (acid). The character {酢|さく} is read さく in this compound but す when used alone as the word for vinegar. This is one of the most familiar organic acids, connecting chemistry to everyday cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酢酸|さくさん}⟦{溶液|ようえき}→溶液：15120_youeki⟧: acetic acid solution
- {酢酸|さくさん}⟦{発酵|はっこう}→発酵：13605_hakkou⟧: acetic acid fermentation
- {酢酸|さくさん}ナトリウム: sodium acetate
- {氷|ひょう}{酢酸|さくさん}: glacial acetic acid

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧: vinegar — the everyday cooking ingredient containing dilute acetic acid
- ⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧: acid — the general chemistry term
- {塩酸|えんさん}: hydrochloric acid — another common acid encountered in school chemistry
- {有機酸|ゆうきさん}: organic acid — the broader category to which acetic acid belongs
